lines.en: label postwarsix1:
scene noonsky
In around one billion years, the inevitable heat death of the planet, brought on by the slowly intensifying nuclear fusion of the sun, will leave oceans dry and the ground beneath our feet scorched.
lines.zh: 大约十亿年后，太阳缓慢加剧的核聚变将带来这颗星球不可避免的热寂死亡，海洋会干涸，我们脚下的土地会被烤焦。

lines.en: In around two billion, Google tells me that something called the “magnetic dynamo” will cease. And that the death of the magnetosphere will cause Earth’s atmospheric gases to bleed out into space.
lines.zh: 大约二十亿年后，Google 告诉我，一种叫做「磁发电机」的东西将会停止运转。而磁层的消亡，会让地球的大气气体流失到太空之中。

lines.en: In about four billion, we’ll basically be Venus.
lines.zh: 大约四十亿年后，我们基本上就成了金星。

lines.en: All life will be extinct and our home will become the birthplace of Destiny 30’s {i}Vault of Glass 2,{/i} a brand new raid in a franchise that will have long outlived its already unnecessary lifespan by then.
lines.zh: 所有生命都将灭绝，而我们的家园会成为《Destiny 30》的{i}玻璃宝库 2{/i}的诞生地——一个全新的突袭副本，而所属系列到那时早已活过了它本就不必要的寿命。

lines.en: Who knows what happens after that?
lines.zh: 之后会发生什么，谁知道呢？

lines.en: Maybe the sun expands and consumes our planet as a whole?
lines.zh: 也许太阳会膨胀，把我们的星球整个吞掉？

lines.en: Maybe there’s some other {i}secret{/i} sun lying in wait for its older brother’s life to start winding down so it can swoop in and assassinate it like in Crusader Kings 3 or some other grand strategy game.
lines.zh: 也许还有某个{i}秘密{/i}的太阳潜伏着，等它兄长的生命开始走向尾声，就猛扑过来暗杀它——就像《Crusader Kings 3》或者别的什么大战略游戏里那样。

lines.en: Or maybe God will save us all!
lines.zh: 又或者，上帝会拯救我们所有人！

lines.en: Not just those who believe, but {i}all{/i} of us because that is what a god should do.
lines.zh: 不只是信祂的人，而是{i}所有{/i}人——因为那才是神该做的事。

lines.en: We still have plenty of time, though. Maybe. Possibly?
lines.zh: 不过我们还有大把时间。大概吧。也许？

lines.en: Is the sun still growing while we bask in its seemingly perpetual rays? The ones that blanket us in fire and heat and cause cancer to those who are too stubborn to ever wear sunscreen.
lines.zh: 当我们沐浴在它那看似永恒的阳光里时，太阳是否还在膨胀？那阳光把我们裹在火与热之中，还让那些倔得死也不肯涂防晒霜的人患上癌症。

lines.en: I bet you’re wearing a hat right now. For reasons no more logical than that I think it would be kind of cool for you to be wearing one.
lines.zh: 我打赌你现在正戴着帽子。理由没什么逻辑，只不过我觉得你戴帽子会挺酷的。

lines.en: You know what? Go put on a hat if you’re not already hatted up and we’ll pick things up from the next text box.
lines.zh: 这样吧：要是你还没戴帽子，就去戴一顶，我们从下一个文本框接着说。

lines.en: Great. Now that your gear is properly equipped, take the hat off. You look stupid. I was wrong.
lines.zh: 很好。既然装备已经穿戴整齐了，把帽子摘了吧。你看着很蠢。我错了。

lines.en: Besides, where we’re going, it’d do little to protect you from the heat anyway. In fact, even sunscreen won’t help! So now’s the perfect time to be stubborn if any!
lines.zh: 再说，我们要去的地方，帽子也挡不了多少热。事实上，连防晒霜都没用！所以现在正是犯倔的最佳时机！

lines.en: You’re being watched again.
lines.zh: 你又被监视了。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk1
: Later, Io! I’ll tell Miss Watabe you can’t come to kyūdō today because of stupid brain stuff! See you back at the dorms!
lines.zh: : 回见，Io！我会跟 Watabe 老师说你今天因为脑子里的蠢毛病没法来弓道！回宿舍见！

lines.en: : Uta, I have to go clean the bathhouse. My brain is weirdly fine right now.
lines.zh: : Uta，我得去打扫澡堂。我的脑子现在出奇地正常。

lines.en: : I know! I just don’t think that excuse would work as well and it’s my job as your best friend to make up for all of your selfish yet lovable flaws through lying! Love you!
lines.zh: : 我知道！我只是觉得那个借口不太好使，而作为你最好的朋友，我的职责就是用谎言来弥补你那些自私却可爱的缺点！爱你！

lines.en: : Aww, I love you too. Now, please excuse me while I get miles away from the creature standing beside you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我也爱你。那么，请允许我离站在你旁边那个生物远一点，越远越好。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk2
: The what?
lines.zh: : 什么生物？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk3
: Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Jesus! How long have you been standing there? And since when are you basically a ninja?
lines.zh: : 天哪！你在那儿站了多久了？还有你什么时候变得跟忍者似的了？

lines.en: : I realized at a young age that stealth would be a very important trait if I ever wanted to spy on my classmates outside of their dorm rooms.
lines.zh: : 我很小就意识到，如果我想在宿舍房间外偷窥同学，潜行会是一项非常重要的技能。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk4
: A worthy time investment, I must say. I’ve learned so much about all of you by listening in on your nightly routines over the last several years.
lines.zh: : 我得说，这笔时间投资很值。过去几年里，光是偷听你们每晚的日常，我就了解到你们这么多事。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk5
: You masturbate {i}a lot,{/i} by the way. More than even I do.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，你自慰得{i}真多{/i}。比我还多。

lines.en: : Wha- no?! Why do you know that thing that most definitely isn’t true?!
lines.zh: : 什——不是？！这种绝对是假的事你怎么会知道？！

lines.en: : Are you free right now, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 你现在有空吗，碰巧的话？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk6
: After that opener?! I don’t think so, lady! And I don’t know what you {i}think{/i} you have planned for me, but it definitely isn’t happening because I’m definitely not interested!
lines.zh: : 开场白是这个？！那可不行，大姐！我也不知道你{i}自以为{/i}在打什么主意，但那绝对不会发生，因为我绝对不感兴趣！

lines.en: : It doesn’t involve masturbation. That was just an ice breaker I employed to try and start this conversation on equal grounds we can both relate to.
lines.zh: : 跟自慰没关系。那只是我用的破冰手段，想让这场对话从我们都能共鸣的平等基础上开始。

lines.en: : It seems my attempt has failed based on your expression, though. Should I go fuck myself now? Figuratively, of course. I have trouble reaching climax in the bathroom here.
lines.zh: : 不过看你的表情，我的尝试似乎失败了。那我现在该去操我自己吗？当然是比喻意义上的。我在这里的洗手间很难高潮。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk7
: What do you want with me, Nodoka? It’s not like you to come up to me after school. And I have club anyway, so...
lines.zh: : 你找我干什么，Nodoka？你平时放学后不会主动来找我的。而且我还有社团活动，所以……

lines.en: : I’d ask if there’s a better time. I just know there isn’t one because today is Thursday and I know that you immediately begin {i}working on yourself{/i} the moment you get home from school.
lines.zh: : 我本想问有没有更合适的时间。只是我知道没有——因为今天是星期四，而我知道你一放学回家就会立刻开始{i}捣鼓自己{/i}。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk8
: Though, I suppose I could just talk to you {i}while{/i} you’re doing that if it makes your schedule any easier to-
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，要是这样你的时间更好安排，我也可以在你做那件事的{i}同时{/i}跟你聊——

lines.en: : IO WORKS LATE ON THURSDAYS! AND STOP SPYING ON ME! THERE’S NO WAY MY MASTURBATION SCHEDULE IS THAT CONSISTENT!
lines.zh: : IO 星期四要加班！还有别再偷窥我了！我的自慰时间表不可能规律成那样！

lines.en: : Understood. I suppose I’ll just leave you alone regarding all things related to the irregular flow of time then.
lines.zh: : 明白了。那么关于时间不规则流动的一切，我就不打扰你了。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk9
: Oh. Is {i}that{/i} what this is about? Because Sensei told me you knew stuff too. I just figured you were up to more Nodoka things based on all the stealth and masturbation stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦。{i}原来{/i}是为这个？因为 Sensei 跟我说你也知道一些事。我只是看你又是潜行又是自慰的，以为你又在搞什么 Nodoka 式的事。

lines.en: : A reasonable assumption. But yes, I’d like to speak with you about your take on all of this seeing as you and I are the newest members of what the rest are calling an “apocalypse squad.”
lines.zh: : 合理的推测。不过没错，我想听听你对这一切的看法——毕竟你和我都是其他人所谓的「末日小队」里最新的成员。

lines.en: : No more weird stuff then? Cause I don’t wanna call out of club if there’s going to be weird stuff.
lines.zh: : 那没有别的奇怪的事了吧？因为要是有奇怪的事，我可不想为此请假不去社团。

lines.en: : Is the fact that we’re perpetually trapped inside a looping high school life not weird to you? Because I sort of agree. I just don’t want to agree to {i}that{/i} in case our outlooks differ in this regard.
lines.zh: : 我们永远被困在不断循环的高中生活里，这件事对你来说不奇怪吗？因为我也多少同意。只是我不想就这么同意{i}这一点{/i}，万一我们在这方面的看法不一样呢。

lines.en: : I meant like sex-weird.
lines.zh: : 我是说性方面的那种奇怪。

lines.en: : That’s like 33%% of my personality. You’d have me suppress that much? What if I can’t think properly?
lines.zh: : 那大概占我人格的百分之三十三。你要我压抑掉那么多？万一我没法正常思考了怎么办？

lines.en: : Who’s second place after me? Assuming I’m in first.
lines.zh: : 我之后排第二的是谁？假设我是第一的话。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk10
: I can show you the entire log if you’re truly interested. I have the dates, times, and session duration listed for every instance I’ve encountered.
lines.zh: : 如果你真有兴趣，我可以把整份记录给你看。每一次我都记了日期、时间和持续时长。

lines.en: : No! Bad Uta! This is forbidden information! You will not stoop to her level {i}regardless{/i} of your insatiable perversions!
lines.zh: : 不！Uta 你给我住手！这是禁忌信息！{i}不管{/i}你那永不满足的变态本性有多强，你都不许堕落到她那个层次！

lines.en: : Besides, you’re only in first place on the second floor. Perhaps you can take some solace in knowing that you’d be second overall if we combined both?
lines.zh: : 再说，你只是在二楼排第一。要是把两层合起来算，你总排名会是第二——知道这点，也许能让你好受些？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk11
: Wait, I do it more than Kirin?! And {i}Molly?!{/i} There’s no way I do it more than Molly! I can hear those sex games she plays through the wall every day!
lines.zh: : 等等，我比 Kirin 还多？！还有{i}Molly{/i}？！我不可能比 Molly 还多吧！我每天都能听见她隔着墙玩那些性爱游戏！

lines.en: : I know you can. Those games aren’t the only sound audible through the walls.
lines.zh: : 我知道你能听见。那些游戏传过来的，可不是唯一能透过墙听见的声音。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk12
: AAAAAAHHHH! FINE! I’LL COME WITH YOU! JUST STOP EMBARRASSING ME IN FRONT OF MY LOCKER! I DON’T KNOW HOW OLD IT IS AND THERE’S A CHANCE IT MIGHT BE SENTIENT!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊！行！我跟你去！别再在我的储物柜面前让我出丑了！我不知道它多大了，说不定它有自我意识！

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk13
scene utanodokatalk14
: So...what are we doing here exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们来这儿到底是干什么的？

lines.en: : Right now? Stopping for a drink. Are you thirsty? This could be a great opportunity for our first indirect kiss.
lines.zh: : 现在？停下来喝点东西。你渴吗？这可是我们第一次间接接吻的大好机会。

lines.en: : I’m good, thanks. It just seems sort of like you made a beeline for this very specific alleyway the moment we left school, so I’m not sure if I’m about to be murdered or not.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。只是感觉我们一离开学校，你就直奔这条特别指定的小巷，所以我不确定自己是不是要被谋杀了。

lines.en: : I’m a pacifist. Something would {i}really{/i} need to break me if I were going to resort to physical violence. And I’m nowhere close to snapping yet.
lines.zh: : 我是个和平主义者。要让我诉诸暴力，得真的有什么东西把我{i}彻底{/i}击垮才行。而我离崩溃还远着呢。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk15
: Who knows given what we’ve learned, though? Because, on one hand, I’m glad to know that time isn’t running out...
lines.zh: : 不过，考虑到我们得知的那些事，谁说得准呢？因为一方面，我很高兴知道时间并没有在流逝……

lines.en: : But, on the other, I understand that when things feel too good to be true, it’s because they are. And that there must be some sort of {i}catch{/i} to all of this that I’m not quite grasping yet.
lines.zh: : 但另一方面，我明白，当事情好得不像真的时，那它就不是真的。而这一切里一定有某种我还没完全抓住的{i}陷阱{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m honestly surprised you haven’t figured this all out already. It isn’t often you’re actually challenged by anything, yeah?
lines.zh: : 说实话，我很惊讶你居然还没把这一切搞明白。你可不是经常被什么东西难住的人，对吧？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk16

: Likewise, you seem quite calm and composed compared to what I’d expect out of a rambunctious and peculiar thing like you. Are you not at all scared to find out that our lives are essentially artificial?
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。比起我对像你这样又闹腾又古怪的家伙的预期，你看起来相当冷静自若。发现我们的生活本质上是人造的，你一点都不害怕吗？

lines.en: : Artificial? That’s not how I look at it at all.
lines.zh: : 人造？我完全不这么看。

lines.en: : How {i}do{/i} you look at it then?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}到底{/i}怎么看？

lines.en: : Batshit crazy.
lines.zh: : 疯得要命。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk17
: But also kind of...relieving in a way?
lines.zh: : 但某种意义上……也挺让人松口气的？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk18
: All this time, I’ve felt like there’s been some sort of clock ticking. {i}Thousands{/i} of clocks, even. And each one was for a different thing I couldn’t bring myself to do anything about.
lines.zh: : 一直以来，我总觉得有什么钟在滴答作响。甚至是{i}成千上万{/i}个钟。而每一个钟，都对应着一件我始终无法说服自己去动手的事。

lines.en: : Not in like one of those...executive dysfunction ways or something like that, though. It’s more just me being afraid of ever upsetting anyone and then...upsetting {i}myself{/i} in the process.
lines.zh: : 不过不是那种……执行功能障碍之类的。更多只是我害怕惹任何人不高兴，然后……在这个过程中又惹{i}自己{/i}不高兴。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk19
: But now...it’s like all of those clocks have stopped all of a sudden. And there’s no pressure to do something {i}right away{/i} anymore because I know we’re not going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 但现在……好像所有那些钟突然都停了。也不再有那种{i}立刻{/i}就得去做点什么的压力了，因为我知道我们哪儿也去不了。

lines.en: : That’s probably why I seem so calm. I {i}feel{/i} calm. Like, don’t get me wrong, this shit’s still Gwen Stefani as hell but, like...okay? I’m down for an infinite loop of hanging out with my friends. Who wouldn’t be?
lines.zh: : 大概这就是为什么我看起来这么平静。我{i}感觉{/i}很平静。怎么说呢，别误会，这破事还是他妈离谱得要死，可是……算了，无所谓？能和朋友们无限循环地待在一起，我乐意。谁会不乐意呢？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk20
: There’s no curiosity then? Of {i}why{/i} this is happening or the key to escaping it? If we can even escape it at all.
lines.zh: : 那就是说你不好奇？不好奇{i}为什么{/i}会这样，或者逃出去的关键？如果我们真能逃出去的话。

lines.en: : There’s {i}curiosity,{/i} sure. It’s a weird thing and I think it’d be cool to know how the weird thing works. But is it enough to, like...{i}do{/i} something about it? Hell no.
lines.zh: : {i}好奇{/i}当然有。这事很怪，我觉得能搞清楚这怪事的原理会很酷。但这够不够让我……{i}做{/i}点什么？当然不够。

lines.en: : I mean, what could someone like me even do to begin with? You and Makoto are the smart ones. I’m just the flirty maid girl who spends Thursdays disappointing her parents.
lines.zh: : 我是说，像我这样的人一开始又能做什么？你和 Makoto 才是聪明人。我只是那个爱调情的女仆女孩，每个星期四都在让父母失望。

lines.en: : So, at the present time, you’re appreciative of this development. Do you worry at all how that may affect the others’ perception of you? Because Akira and Ayane seem rather anxious to escape this all.
lines.zh: : 那么，就目前而言，你很感激这个进展。你一点也不担心这会影响其他人对你的看法吗？因为 Akira 和 Ayane 看起来相当急于逃离这一切。

lines.en: : Of course I worry. I {i}always{/i} worry about what other people think of me. It’s, like...baked into who I am and I don’t think it’s possible for me to change that.
lines.zh: : 我当然担心。我{i}一直{/i}都在担心别人怎么看我。这……就像是刻在我骨子里的东西，我觉得自己不可能改掉。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk21
: But at the same time...maybe this could be a chance to work on that?
lines.zh: : 但与此同时……也许这是个改一改的机会？

lines.en: : Maybe, if I can take my time...I can make a newer...even {i}more{/i} desirable version of Uta. One that’s actually brave and assertive and actually {i}does{/i} something instead of just watching from the sidelines.
lines.zh: : 也许，如果我能慢慢来……我能造出一个更新、甚至{i}更{/i}讨人喜欢的 Uta。一个真正勇敢、有主见、真正会去{i}做{/i}点什么，而不是只在旁边看着的 Uta。

lines.en: : I’d be stupid not to jump on a chance like that, wouldn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我要是不抓住这种机会，那才叫傻呢，对吧？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk19
: Why do you even want to know, though? Like why do this alone instead of with the rest of the squad? It’s not really {i}just{/i} because you and me are the newbies, is it?
lines.zh: : 可你到底为什么想知道？为什么要单独找我，而不是跟小队其他人一起？不可能{i}只是{/i}因为你和我是新人吧？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk22
: Of course not. I’m sure you know well enough by now that I’m not one to act without reason.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我相信你现在已经很清楚，我做事不会没有理由。

lines.en: : Something many fail to understand, though, is that I do these things not out of malice, but necessity.
lines.zh: : 不过很多人不明白的是，我做这些事不是出于恶意，而是出于必要。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk23
: Yet, alas — I’ve found myself questioning {i}necessity{/i} as a whole lately.
lines.zh: : 然而，唉——最近我发现自己开始质疑「{i}必要{/i}」这件事本身了。

lines.en: : I wonder...how much suffering in the hands of others would you accept to enrich your {i}own{/i} life, Uta? Because, at the moment, it appears that you wouldn’t accept any at all.
lines.zh: : 我在想……为了让你{i}自己{/i}的人生更丰盛，你愿意接受别人在你手上承受多少痛苦，Uta？因为就目前看来，你似乎一点都不愿意接受。

lines.en: : But this {i}better{/i} version of yourself that you want to build would surely need to accept {i}some,{/i} would she not? So how much is acceptable?
lines.zh: : 可你想打造的那个{i}更好{/i}的自己，总该要接受{i}一些{/i}吧？那么多少才算可以接受？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk24
: And would you call me a bad girl if I watched those closest to me suffer without so much as lending a hand?
lines.zh: : 还有，如果我眼睁睁看着最亲近的人受苦，连手都不伸一下，你会说我是个坏女孩吗？

lines.en: : Can I be brutally honest for a second, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 我能说句非常难听的实话吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : Of course. You’ve seen firsthand that if anyone can take a beating, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 当然。你亲眼见过，要说谁能挨得住打击，那就是我。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk25
: Great! Well, in that case, you’re {i}already{/i} a bad girl. So bad, in fact, that I find myself silently wishing harm upon you every time I see your face.
lines.zh: : 太好了！那么，既然如此，你{i}已经{/i}是个坏女孩了。坏到什么程度呢——每次看到你的脸，我都会在心里默默盼着你倒霉。

lines.en: : Do I {i}want{/i} to feel that way? Of course not. But I do! Because you’re an unfiltered, insensitive, selfish bitch who is chased by a cloud of misery raining sadness upon everyone else you associate with.
lines.zh: : 我{i}想{/i}这么想吗？当然不想。可我就是这样！因为你是个毫无遮拦、麻木不仁、自私自利的婊子，身后追着一团悲惨的乌云，把悲伤下在每一个和你有牵扯的人身上。

lines.en: : And the only reason I can {i}smile{/i} right now despite being drenched in your presence is because I have so much practice pretending to be happy when I’m not! I don’t like you. You’re a {i}very{/i} bad girl.
lines.zh: : 而我之所以能在你身边被淋得透湿、还能{i}笑{/i}得出来，全靠我练习了太多次在不开心时装开心！我不喜欢你。你是个{i}非常{/i}坏的女孩。

lines.en: : I agree.
lines.zh: : 我同意。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk26
: Well, {i}don’t{/i} because it undercuts everything I just said and makes {i}me{/i} look like the bad guy instead for pointing it out!
lines.zh: : 别{i}同意{/i}啊，因为你这么一说，我刚才说的全被削弱了，反倒显得{i}我{/i}像个指出这点的坏人！

lines.en: : This is about Io, isn’t it? You’ve held this in for quite a long time.
lines.zh: : 这是关于 Io 的，对吧？你在心里憋了很久了。

lines.en: : If you haven’t noticed, I’ve been doing a pretty great job of never having a full-length conversation with you!
lines.zh: : 你没发现吗？我已经很成功地一直没跟你进行过一次完整的对话了！

lines.en: : Then you had to go and ruin it all by dragging me into some random alley and asking me if I’m thirsty and also knowing my masturbation schedule! You’re so bad and you only get away with it because you’re hot!
lines.zh: : 结果你非得把我拽进一条莫名其妙的小巷、问我渴不渴、还知道我的自慰时间表，把一切都毁了！你真是坏透了，而你之所以能逍遥法外，全靠你长得好看！

lines.en: : I’m sorry for what happened back then. And I’m sorry now for drenching you in secondhand sorrow.
lines.zh: : 我为那时发生的事道歉。也为现在把你淋了一身二手的悲伤而道歉。

lines.en: : Stop apologizing and just let me be mean for another minute! I never get to do that and you gave me permission to be brutally honest!
lines.zh: : 别道歉了，让我再刻薄一分钟！我从来没机会这样，而且是你允许我说难听的实话的！

lines.en: : Apologies. By all means, go right ahead.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。请便，尽管说。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk27
: Great! Well, now I can’t think of anything so just say whatever you were about to say and I’ll try to think of more stuff about you to complain about!
lines.zh: : 好！嗯，现在我什么也想不出来了，所以你该说什么就说什么吧，我再努力想点关于你的抱怨！

lines.en: : All I’m really saying is that this recent revelation has somehow brought me {i}closer{/i} to earth than I’ve ever been before.
lines.zh: : 我其实想说的是，最近这个真相，不知怎么让我{i}更贴近{/i}地面了——比我以往任何时候都贴近。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk28
: And that I’m surprising even myself by how little I want to know the answers I’ve been searching for my whole life now that they’re finally within my reach.
lines.zh: : 还有，连我自己都惊讶——那些我追寻了一生的答案，如今终于触手可及，我却是如此不想知道。

lines.en: : Could this be the fear of finality, perhaps? The fear of being wrong? Or do I, too, just wish to become someone {i}better{/i} than who I am now?
lines.zh: : 这会不会是对终结的恐惧？对犯错的恐惧？还是说，我也一样，只是想变成一个比现在{i}更好{/i}的人？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk29

: I admire you. Being able to identify your own flaws. Being able to {i}change{/i} at will. So much so that I’d wish to trade my knowledge for that if said knowledge didn’t prevent me from actually doing so.
lines.zh: : 我敬佩你。能看清自己的缺点。能随心所欲地{i}改变{/i}。我敬佩到甚至想用我的知识去换这种能力——如果不是这些知识本身就阻止了我这么做的话。

lines.en: : Uhh...th...thank you?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢……谢谢？

lines.en: : Have you thought up any more mean things to say to me yet?
lines.zh: : 你还没想出更多说我坏话的话吗？

lines.en: : You...uh...
: You smell too much like coffee sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你有时候身上的咖啡味太重了。

lines.en: : I did not realize this was a character flaw. Does everyone think that?
lines.zh: : 我没意识到这算性格缺陷。大家都这么觉得吗？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk30

: {size=-2}I don’t know what everyone thinks, Nodoka. I can wager a guess but, as someone who spends every waking moment trying to uncover our stories like we’re characters in some book, I think you’d do a better job than me at it.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我不知道大家怎么想，Nodoka。我可以猜一猜，但作为一个醒着的每一刻都在试图挖出我们的故事、好像我们是某本书里的角色的人，我觉得这种事你比我擅长。{/size}

lines.en: : Do you think anyone will ever understand me? The way I do them.
lines.zh: : 你觉得会有人真正理解我吗？就像我理解他们那样。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk31
: What, by going up to some podium and revealing your deepest traumas to everyone over a PA system?
lines.zh: : 怎么，要你站上讲台，用广播把你最深的心理创伤向所有人广播出来吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure I have any trauma, to be honest. I’m not really sure what you’d say.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我不确定自己有什么创伤。我真不知道你会说什么。

lines.en: : Well, {i}lucky you.{/i} Maybe you’d be a little more careful if you had something you were ashamed of. Or hurt by. Or something that scared you. But you don’t.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}你真走运{/i}。要是你有什么羞于启齿的事、被伤害过的事、或者让你害怕的事，也许你会小心一点。可你没有。

lines.en: : And I don’t want to say you never will because I {i}hope{/i} you do. I just...you piss me off. And it pisses me off even more that you pulled me out here without ever even acknowledging that I might feel that way.
lines.zh: : 我也不想说你永远不会有，因为我{i}希望{/i}你有。我只是……你让我很火大。而更让我火大的是，你把我拽到这儿来，却从来没有承认过我可能会有这种感受。

lines.en: : It just felt like an unrelated topic to me. I didn’t expect the conversation to take a turn in this direction when I confronted you about time loops.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得那是个无关的话题。我找你谈时间循环的时候，没想到对话会转到这个方向。

lines.en: : I don’t care about time loops. Especially when the only reason I’m probably aware of them in the first place is because of a ghost. Life doesn’t make sense. Just leave Io alone, okay?
lines.zh: : 我不在乎什么时间循环。尤其是一开始我之所以会知道，大概还是因为一个鬼。生活本来就没道理。别去招惹 Io，好吗？

lines.en: : A ghost?
lines.zh: : 一个鬼？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk32
: Just a weird dream I had when I zoned out at the maid cafe. I’d say it’s probably nothing but who the heck even knows at this point?
lines.zh: : 就是我在女仆咖啡厅发呆时做的一个怪梦。我大概会说那没什么，可事到如今谁他妈说得准呢？

lines.en: : She didn’t have blue eyes, did she? A flower in her hair?
lines.zh: : 她没有蓝色的眼睛吧？头发上插着一朵花？

lines.en: : No, weirder. It was Ami’s mom.
lines.zh: : 不是，更怪。是 Ami 的妈妈。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk33
: What?...
: Don’t tell her I said anything, though. I’m giving you one chance to kind of maybe partially redeem yourself here. And things are already weird enough with me and Ami as-is.
lines.zh: : 不过别跟她说是我讲的。我这是给你一个机会，让你稍微、大概、部分地挽回一下自己。我和 Ami 之间已经够奇怪的了。

lines.en: : You saw her?...The Girl Who Cannot Breathe?
lines.zh: : 你见到她了？……那个无法呼吸的女孩？

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk34
: That’s...a weird way to refer to a dead person. But yeah? Or at least someone who claimed to be Ami’s mom. But it’s not like I ever saw her in real life and-
lines.zh: : 这……称呼一个死人的方式挺怪的。不过对吧？或者至少是个自称 Ami 妈妈的人。可我现实中又从没见过她，而且——

lines.en: : This changes things.
lines.zh: : 这改变了局势。

lines.en: : I need to go think.
lines.zh: : 我需要去想一想。

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk35
: What?! You’re just leaving?! You’re not even going to walk me back to the dorm?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你就这么走了？！你连送我回宿舍都不送？！

lines.en: : I might hate you, but I’m still a cute girl, you know! We need to move in pairs! There are all sorts of weird people on the loose out there!
lines.zh: : 我也许是讨厌你，可我好歹是个可爱的女孩子啊！我们必须结伴行动！外面有各种各样的怪人在游荡！

lines.en: : {i}So he can see her...and she can see her...but I can’t see her?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所以他能看见她……她也能看见她……可我看不见她？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Does this mean...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这是否意味着……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Kyoko...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Kyoko……{/i}

lines.en: scene utanodokatalk36
: {i}Nodoka! Mumbling to yourself in public is going to attract the exact people I just warned you about!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Nodoka！在公共场合自言自语，正好会招来我刚刚警告过你的那种人！{/i}

lines.en: scene black
In ten billion years, there will be nothing left.
lines.zh: 一百亿年后，什么都不复存在。

lines.en: But I will still be here.
lines.zh: 但我仍会在这里。

lines.en: And you...
lines.zh: 而你……

lines.en: You will have wished you had believed.
lines.zh: 你会希望自己当初相信过。
